atoms.b: Deforestation is a major factor in climate change. ((++Trees Boxes)) absorb CO<sub>2</sub>, and breathe out ((++oxygen fire)). Cutting them down means that the CO<sub>2</sub> we release goes into the atmosphere instead.
A lot of the Earth’s CO<sub>2</sub> is currently stored inside trees, so when they are cut down, the stored CO<sub>2</sub> is released back into the ((++atmosphere skin)).

text: This is the Amazon, the largest rainforest on Earth and home to millions of different types of animals.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: In 2024, 44.2 million acres of the Amazon rainforest burned down — an area larger than England! Normally, the moisture in the rainforest can help to prevent fires, but climate change has caused more drought in the region.
Every minute, a patch of rainforest the size of a football pitch is cut down in the Amazon, mostly for cattle farming. In fact, farmers and companies often illegally start the fires themselves.

atoms.a: Why is the Amazon becoming more vulnerable to forest fires?
What is the main reason for deforestation in the Amazon?
